pages.text: Conduits carry $(l)FE$() from generators to machines, so they no longer need to touch each other. You can tell them by the cyan lights on their sleeves, and while energy flows a $(l)cyan arc$() runs through their glass.

$(li)Conduits $(l)connect by themselves$() to other conduits and to any block that uses FE, from CyberFarm or from any other mod.$(br)$(li)They $(l)store nothing$(): whatever a generator pushes in goes straight to the machines on the network, which $(l)take turns$() so none is left without power.$(br)$(li)From each

$(li)generator or battery pushing into it, up to $(l)2,000 FE/t$() enters the network through a basic conduit, $(l)16,000$() through an Advanced one and $(l)128,000$() through an Elite one. A Medium Steam Turbine needs Advanced conduits at its ports, a Large one Elite conduits.
$(li)All tiers join into one network.$(br)$(li)Networks can be up to 1,024 conduits long.
